## Compare 16s/ITS versus ME-NMR 

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXlong <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) %>% 
  psmelt() %>%  
  dplyr::select(OTU:TSP, ta1:ta7) %>% 
  full_join(MEconc_newlong %>% 
              filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% 
              filter(`Blood origen`=='ME') , 
            by = c('Sample.ID' = 'Sample ID', 'Participant', 'Period')) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Abundance)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(logy)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(met,'EREC')) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(met,'TSP')) %>% 
  dplyr::select(OTU:ta7,met,category, type:logy,oldlogy)


tb_cor <- phyXlong %>% 
  group_by(OTU,met,ta1,ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7) %>% 
  do(cor.test(data = ., ~ logy + Abundance,method = 'spearman') %>% tidy)

tb_lmer <- phyXlong %>% 
  # filter(met=='uridine') %>% 
  # filter(OTU=='sp1') %>% 
  mutate(logabu = log(Abundance+0.0001)) %>% 
  group_by(OTU,met,ta1,ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5,ta6,ta7) %>% 
  do(lmer(data = ., logy ~  logabu + factor(day) + (1|Participant) + (logabu|Participant)) %>% tidy)

# tb_lmer %>% filter(str_detect(term,'log')) %>% arrange(p.value)


save(file = 'microbiome_vs_nmr_models.RData', list = c('tb_lmer', 'tb_cor','phyXlong'))
```

### Multivariate prediciton models using nested-cv

```{r}
library(caret)
library(nestedcv)

make_loio_folds <- function(ids) {
  if (anyNA(ids)) {
    stop("ids must not contain missing values")
  }
  
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  n_ids <- length(unique(ids))
  
  if (n_ids < 3L) {
    stop("At least three unique IDs are required for nested leave-one-ID-out CV")
  }
  
  # Outer test folds: indices refer to rows in the complete dataset
  outer_folds <- split(
    seq_along(ids),
    factor(ids, levels = unique(ids))
  )
  
  # Inner test folds: indices refer to rows in each outer-training dataset
  inner_folds <- lapply(outer_folds, function(outer_test) {
    outer_train <- setdiff(seq_along(ids), outer_test)
    train_ids   <- ids[outer_train]
    
    split(
      seq_along(train_ids),
      factor(train_ids, levels = unique(train_ids))
    )
  })
  
  list(
    outer_folds = unname(outer_folds),
    inner_folds = lapply(inner_folds, unname)
  )
}




```

#### From 16s to NMR

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXpp <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(X2.hydroxyisovaleric.acid)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) 

X <- phyXpp@otu_table %>% data.frame()
X <- log(X + +0.0001)
Y <- phyXpp@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(-TSP,-ERECTIC)

folds <- make_loio_folds(Y$Participant)
nmiss <- 1

while (nmiss>0) {
  unmet <- unique(MEconc_newlong$met) 
  unmet2 <- unmet <- unmet[!(unmet %in% c("ERECTIC","TSP"))]
  unmet <- unmet %>% 
    gsub('-','',x = .) %>% 
    gsub(' ','',x = .) %>% 
    gsub(',','',x = .)
  
  fls <- list.files('MLresults16s/') %>% substr(30,100) %>% gsub('_v2.RData','',x = .)
  unmet2 <- unmet2[!(unmet %in% fls)]
  nmiss <- length(unmet2)
  
  # select a random metabolite from the remaining list 
  i <- sample(unmet2)[1]
  print(i)
  flnm <- paste('./MLresults16s/metabolite_16smodels_nestedcv',
                i %>% 
                  gsub('-','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(' ','',x = .) %>% 
                  gsub(',','',x = .),
                '_v2.RData', sep = '')
  save(file = flnm, list = c('i'))
  yy <- MEconc_newlong %>% filter(met==i) %>% filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% filter(`Blood origen`=='ME')
  
  YY <- Y %>% 
    left_join(yy, by = c('Participant','Period','Cycle.day' = 'Cycle day'))
  
  y <- YY$logy
  sdy <- sd(y)
  
  fit <- nestedcv::nestcv.train(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    method = "spls",                  # any caret model
    preProc = c("center", 'scale'),
    tuneGrid = expand.grid(K = 1:3,# K sets number of components
                           eta = seq(0,1,0.1), # eta sets sparsity
                           kappa = 0.5),
    outer_folds = folds$outer_folds,
    inner_folds = folds$inner_folds,
    finalCV = FALSE,
    cv.cores = 1
  )
  
  fit$sdy <- sdy
  fit$metabolite <- i
  
  
  save(file = flnm, list = c('fit','i'))
}

```

#### Permutation null

```{r, eval=FALSE}
phyXpp <- phyX %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(Sample.ID)) %>% 
  subset_samples(!is.na(X2.hydroxyisovaleric.acid)) %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>% 
  filter_taxa(function(x) sum(x > 0)>10, TRUE) 

X <- phyXpp@otu_table %>% data.frame()
X <- log(X + +0.0001)
Y <- phyXpp@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(-TSP,-ERECTIC)

c <- 0
CVindex <- list()
for (i in unique(Y$Participant)) {
  c <- c+1
  CVindex[[c]] <- which(Y$Participant!=i)
}


folds <- make_loio_folds(Y$Participant)
nfls <- 1

unmet <- unique(MEconc_newlong$met)
unmet2 <- unmet <- unmet[!(unmet %in% c("ERECTIC","TSP"))]

while (nfls<100) {
  # select a random metabolite from the remaining list 
  i <- sample(unmet2)[1]
  print(i)
  
  yy <- MEconc_newlong %>% filter(met==i) %>% filter(!is.na(Participant)) %>% filter(`Blood origen`=='ME')
  
  YY <- Y %>% 
    left_join(yy, by = c('Participant','Period','Cycle.day' = 'Cycle day'))
  
  y <- sample(YY$logy) # permute 
  sdy <- sd(y)
  
  fit <- nestedcv::nestcv.train(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    method = "spls",                  # any caret model
    preProc = c("center", 'scale'),
    tuneGrid = expand.grid(K = 1:3,# K sets number of components
                           eta = seq(0,1,0.1), # eta sets sparsity
                           kappa = 0.5),
    outer_folds = folds$outer_folds,
    inner_folds = folds$inner_folds,
    finalCV = FALSE,
    cv.cores = 1
  )
  
  fit$sdy <- sdy
  fit$metabolite <- i
  
  yhat <- y
  for (ii in 1:18){
    notin <- logical(length(y))
    notin[CVindex[[ii]]] <- TRUE
    # print(mean(y[notin]))
    yhat[!notin] <- mean(y[notin])
  }
  e <- y - yhat
  fit$rmse0 <- caret::RMSE(yhat,y)
  
  summary(fit)
  fit$rmse0
  
  nfls <- list.files('MLresults16sperm/') %>% length
  flnm <- paste('./MLresults16sperm/metabolite_16smodels_nestedcv_iter',nfls+1,
                '_v2.RData', sep = '')
  save(file = flnm, list = c('fit'))
}

```

### Estimate FDR based on permutation-null

We have constructed a null distribution using identical ML approach including leave-one-person-out CV on scrambled response variables (metabolite concentration).

We have recorded both the mean-only model (RMSE0) as well as the RMSE from the ML procedure and calculated the observed R2 as listed above. 

This R2 null distribution is used to estimate the probability under under no-information of observing a value of R2* or larger. 
Due to limited observations in the tails under permutation, this part of the distribution is estimated using a generalized pareto distribution with a tail from the 0.7 fractile and up. 

This smooth functional form of the distribution is used to calculate the mass under null and contrasting this with the actual fraction of discoveries as a empirical false discovery rate. 

```{r}
load(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/MLstats.RData')

load(file = '~/OneDrive - University of Copenhagen/KU_work/menstrual_effluent/multiomics_menstrual_effluent/permutation_stats.RData')

library(mev)

res <- resperm %>% 
  filter(stat=='RMSE') %>% 
  mutate(R2 = 1 - x^2 / rmse0^2) %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(paste(x,metabolite))) %>% 
  group_by(method) %>% 
  arrange(R2) %>% 
  mutate(nn = 1, 
         cdf = cumsum(nn) / sum(nn))

res %>% ggplot(data = ., aes(R2)) + geom_histogram() + facet_wrap(~method)
```


```{r}
DFprob <- data.frame()
for (mth in unique(res$method)){
  MLstatsel <- MLstat %>% filter(method==mth)
  ressel <- res %>% filter(method==mth)
  data_points <- ressel$R2
  
  threshold_val <- quantile(data_points, 0.70)
  
  gpd_fit <- fit.gpd(xdat = data_points, 
                     threshold = threshold_val, 
                     method = "Grimshaw")
  
  # --- 2. Extract the Parameter Estimates ---
  sigma <- gpd_fit$estimate[1] %>% as.numeric() # Scale parameter
  xi    <- gpd_fit$estimate[2] %>% as.numeric()  # Shape parameter
  u     <- gpd_fit$threshold %>% as.numeric()     # Threshold value
  
  # Calculate empirical probability of exceeding the threshold (zeta)
  n_total     <- length(data_points)
  n_exceed    <- sum(data_points > u)
  zeta_u      <- n_exceed / n_total
  
  # Using mev's built-in GPD distribution function (pgp)
  dfprob <- data.frame(x = seq(u,0.5,0.001))
  dfprob2 <- data.frame(x = seq(min(data_points),u,0.001))
  dfprob$condp <- pgp(dfprob$x, loc = u, scale = sigma, shape = xi)
  dfprob$uncondp <- (1 - zeta_u) + zeta_u * dfprob$condp
  dfprob <- bind_rows(dfprob,dfprob2) %>% mutate(method = mth)
  
  dfprob$cdf <- NA
  
  nmet <- dim(MLstatsel)[1]
  for (i in 1:dim(dfprob)[1]){
    dfprob$cdf[i] <- ressel$cdf[max(which(ressel$R2<dfprob$x[i]))]
    dfprob$frac_disc[i] <- sum(MLstatsel$Rsquared>dfprob$x[i]) / nmet
  }
  
  DFprob <- bind_rows(DFprob,dfprob)
}

DFprob <- DFprob %>% 
  # for each value of R2 (in increasing order calculate the FDR value as the propotion of discoveries under null divided by the total proportion)
  mutate(fdr = (1-uncondp) / frac_disc) 

dffdr <- DFprob %>% 
  group_by(method) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(fdr)) %>% 
  filter(fdr<0.05) %>% 
  arrange(x) %>% 
  slice(1)

DFprob %>% 
  group_by(method) %>% 
  gather(m,p,cdf,uncondp) %>% 
  mutate(m = m %>% factor(labels = c('Empirical','GPDestimate'))) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(x,p,color = m)) + 
  geom_line(size = 2) + 
  facet_wrap(~method) + 
  geom_vline(data = dffdr, aes(xintercept = x)) +
  xlab('R2') + theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

```

```{r}
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  # geom_hline(data = data.frame(R2cut = c(R2sign_16s,R2sign_ITS), method = c('16s','ITS')), 
  # aes(yintercept = R2cut, color = method)) + 
  # geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), aes(group = method), size = 1) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorcodes[1:2], labels = colorcodesnames[1:2]) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colorcodes[1:2], labels = colorcodesnames[1:2], guide = 'none') + 
  # scale_x_discrete(breaks = dflb$lb[1:9], values = dflb$lb[1:9]) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust =  0), 
        legend.position = 'bottom') + labs(fill = NULL) + 
  xlab(NULL)
g_r2
```

Figure 5A in publication

```{r}
library(gplots)

ggbeta <- beta %>% 
  left_join(MLstat %>% dplyr::select(rmse0,x,Rsquared, metabolite,method,ncomp), by = c('metabolite','method')) %>% 
  left_join(dflb, by = 'category') %>%
  mutate(breg = breg/sdy) %>% 
  filter(method == '16s') %>% 
  filter(Rsquared>0.45) %>% 
  left_join(tb_lmer2 %>% dplyr::select(OTU,met,estimate:pvcut), by = c('OTU','metabolite' = 'met')) %>% 
  group_by(metabolite) %>% 
  mutate(nn = sum(abs(breg)>0)) %>% 
  filter(nn>0) %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  mutate(nn2 = sum(abs(breg)>0)) %>% 
  filter(nn2>0) %>% 
  left_join(phyX@tax_table %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column('OTU') %>% 
              left_join(bsum16s, by = c('ta2','ta3','ta4','ta5')), by = 'OTU') %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(taxall = paste(ta2,ta3,ta4,ta5, sep = '') %>% factor() %>% as.numeric(),
         OTU = OTU %>% fct_reorder(taxall)) %>% 
  mutate(stars = gtools::stars.pval(qval)) 

lbs <- ggbeta %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(lb = ta5[1], 
                   lb4 = ta4[1], 
                   lb3 = ta3[1], 
                   lb2 = ta2[1], 
                   n()) %>% 
  arrange(lb)

# 1) find lowest level of id, 2) remove F__
for (i in which(nchar(lbs$lb)<4)){
  id <- which(nchar(lbs[i,])>4)[1]
  if (is.na(id)) {
    lbs$lb[i] <- 'unassigned'
  }
  else {
    # print(as.character(lbs[i,id]))
    lbs$lb[i] <- as.character(lbs[i,id])
  }
}

lbs <- lbs %>% 
  mutate(lb = lb %>% 
           gsub('F__','',x = .) %>% 
           gsub('__','-',x = .))


g5_all <- ggbeta %>% 
  # remove bin from mtb label
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('bin.','',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  # filter of only bins / unk
  # filter(nchar(metabolite)>6) %>% 
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('X2.','2-',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  # filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'unk')) %>% 
  # filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'1_2')) %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(metabolite,OTU,fill = breg,color = factor(sign(breg)), label = stars)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  geom_text(color = 'black') + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = lbs$lb,breaks =lbs$OTU ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = 'white',midpoint = 0) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c('red4',"#FFFFFF00",'blue2'), guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top', axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) + 
  xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)


g5_sel <- ggbeta %>% 
  # remove bin from mtb label
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('bin-','',x = metabolite)) %>% 
  mutate(metabolite = gsub('1_2','',x = metabolite) %>% trimws()) %>% 
  # filter of only bins / unk
  filter(nchar(metabolite)>6) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'unk')) %>%
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  mutate(nactive = sum(abs(breg))) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  filter(nactive>0.0001) %>% 
  # group_by(metabolite) %>%
  # mutate(breg = breg / max(abs(breg))) %>% 
  # filter(!str_detect(metabolite,'1_2')) %>%
  ggplot(data = ., aes(metabolite,OTU,fill = breg,color = factor(sign(breg)), label = stars)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = lbs$lb,breaks =lbs$OTU ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('red4',"#FFFFFF00",'blue2'), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = 'white',midpoint = 0) + 
  geom_text(color = 'black') + 
  # scale_color_manual(values = alpha(c('white','black'))) + #,c(0,1))) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'top', axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) + 
  # guides(color = guide_legend(NULL))+
  xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)
```
